title: TriageCoreFeatures
description: Feature vector used for prioritising triage submissions. All values are normalised to the range [0, 1] unless specified otherwise.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the feature payload. Bump on backwards-incompatible changes.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the feature vector was produced (UTC).

acuity.description: Predicted emergency probability or severity score.

risk.description: Risk-of-deterioration signal derived from patient history.

complexity.description: Operational complexity estimate capturing comorbidities and care coordination needs.

time.description: Time-sensitivity score (e.g., symptom onset, follow-up deadlines).

compositeScore.description: Weighted score computed from the component features.

source.description: Identifier of the pipeline or model that produced the feature vector.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry timestamp (UTC) after which the vector should be refreshed.

extensions.description: Reserved for additive signals that do not yet justify a schema bump. Keys must be lowerCamelCase.
